categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and touches Guix build manifests and prelude scripts ('contrib/guix/manifest_gui.scm', 'contrib/guix/libexec/prelude.bash').
categories.rationale: Updates Guix time-machine to support native builds on RISC-V architectures and bypasses upstream test failures on riscv64 hosts. While enabling builds on an emerging architecture is useful, native RISC-V host building is not a tier-1 supported release platform, making this reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Guix scripts and manifests belong under build and release infrastructure, not general operator or developer tooling.
categories.rationale: The category definition specifically notes that build and release scripts are build, not tools.
